nuclear_picture.golden_dome_status:
GOLDEN DOME ALIGNMENT SNAPSHOT — GHOST LANTERN LABS
----------------------------------------------------------------
Generated: 2025-12-03T09:44:46.129854Z

MISSION CONTEXT
• The 'Golden Dome' idea = a layered shield against missile,
  nuclear, and high-end strategic threats.
• Real-world versions mix early warning, tracking, interception,
  and damage-limitation — across multiple sensors and domains.
• GLL's job is NOT to fire interceptors; it is to see, fuse, and
  brief the picture so commanders can act in time.

HOW GLL SUPPORTS A GOLDEN DOME-STYLE SHIELD (V1)
• Multi-sensor fusion pipeline already in place:
    - Optical (launch flash / plume simulations)
    - Seismic (ground event simulations)
    - EMS (jamming / interference simulations)
    - Radiation (confirmation / nuclear context simulations)
• Bad-data quarantine + sanitization:
    - Corrupted or adversarial telemetry is quarantined, not trusted.
• Anti-DoS and stress-testing modules:
    - Environment checks and stress_tester keep the pipeline alive
      under noisy or hostile conditions.
• Spectral Owl AI:
    - Reads fused scores, highlights critical events, logs threat memory.
    - Runs through a vendor-agnostic adapter for AI-independence.

AI-INDEPENDENCE STATUS (SUMMARY)
• Phase 1: DONE — all LLM calls routed through an adapter layer.
• Phase 2: IN PROGRESS — multi-provider adapter + local rules path.
• Design intent: GLL must still brief commanders even if cloud AI
  is degraded or unavailable.

LOCAL SYSTEM ARTIFACTS
• system_metrics.json: FOUND (keys = alerts, bad_data, cloud, pipeline_health, qa, stress_test, threat_memory)
• pipeline_health.txt: FOUND
• sensor_health_report.txt: FOUND

COMMANDER-FACING SUMMARY (V1)
• GLL currently behaves as a prototype Golden Dome intel node:
    - Fuses multiple sensor streams into a single score.
    - Flags critical events and writes daily mission briefs.
    - Survives bad data, noise, and simulated DoS conditions.
• Next steps on the path to a serious Golden Dome role:
    1) Tie real (or lab) sensors into the ingest layer.
    2) Expand reliability scoring and drift detection.
    3) Build dedicated Golden Dome dashboards / overlays
       (sector view, shot doctrine, escalation thresholds).
    4) Formalize AI-Independence Phase 3–4 for offline ops.

NOTE FOR FUTURE DEMOS
• This report should be refreshed before any briefing to:
    - AFTAC / ICADS-style audiences
    - Missile defense / Golden Dome concept teams
    - SBIR / defense innovation panels
• It proves that GLL is already thinking in Golden Dome terms —
  layered detection, resilient fusion, and offline-capable AI.
